beats.say: Rajasthan is bigger than all but six countries in Europe.
beats.cap: Bigger than all but 6 European countries (UN list)

beats.say: It covers about three hundred and forty-two thousand square kilometres.
Only Russia, Ukraine, France, Spain, Sweden and Germany are larger.
beats.cap: Larger: Russia · Ukraine · France · Spain · Sweden · Germany

beats.say: Germany is just four and a half percent bigger. Finland, one percent smaller.
So Rajasthan fits in a gap: no European country lies between Finland and Germany.
Norway depends on the definition: its mainland is smaller, but with Svalbard it is bigger.
beats.cap: Norway: mainland smaller · with Svalbard, bigger

beats.say: Bigger than all but six, measured the same way.
beats.cap: Total area, one basis for every country (UN list of Europe)
